stories.title: Treasury secretary confirms AI talks with China are underway ahead of Trump-Xi summit
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. Treasury secretary is talking with China about artificial intelligence rules and safety. These talks are happening before the president meets with China's leader.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and government policy people — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Op-eds, academic articles by Provost Santiago Schnell flagged as ‘AI-written’ by ‘near-zero error’ AI detector Pangram
stories.simple_summary: A software tool said it found that articles written by a college leader were actually written by AI, not by a human. The college leader says this is wrong.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI detection tools can make mistakes, which matters if you worry about whether something you read was written by a real person or a machine.

stories.title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
stories.simple_summary: Meta created an AI robot shopper called Muse that could buy things on Amazon. Amazon has now blocked it from shopping there anymore.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is starting a group to think about how AI relates to mathematics and learning.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and scientists — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: U.N. Seeks Relevance on A.I. as the U.S. and China Race Ahead
stories.simple_summary: The United Nations is worried that the U.S. and China are moving fast on AI while the U.N. is not involved in those decisions.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: With Tabby, a former accountant is using AI to make accountants obsolete
stories.simple_summary: Someone created a tool called Tabby that uses AI to do bookkeeping work — tracking money in and out of a business. The creator wants it to eventually replace human accountants.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business with lots of paperwork, this kind of tool might eventually help you keep track of your money faster, though a human accountant will still be valuable for advice.

stories.title: Bill Gates says Trump's AI views point to societal blind spot
stories.simple_summary: Bill Gates said that some people in charge are not paying enough attention to important AI issues.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to policy leaders and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Google’s $899 Googlebook is a bet that you’ll buy a new laptop for Gemini
stories.simple_summary: Google made a new laptop computer for $899 that is designed to work closely with Gemini, which is Google's AI assistant. The idea is that AI is built into everything you do on the computer.
stories.why_it_matters: If you buy a new laptop soon, you may find AI features built in to help with writing, searching, and other tasks — you should try them out to see if they help you work.
